hero.title: Confirm orders automatically before you ship them.
hero.subtitle: Akedly messages every new order on WhatsApp and asks the customer to confirm or cancel — so you stop packing orders nobody wants.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Four steps, no manual follow-up calls.
howItWorks.step1Body: A customer checks out on your Shopify or WooCommerce store.
howItWorks.step2Body: The customer gets order details with two buttons: Confirm or Cancel.
howItWorks.step3Body: One tap. No app to install, no phone call to answer.
howItWorks.step4Body: Akedly records the result and syncs it back to your store.

why.title: Why merchants add Akedly
why.item1Body: Confirm intent before a courier is on the way, not after.
why.item2Body: Replace manual confirmation calls with a message customers already read.
why.item3Body: Every message sent and every reply received, timestamped per order.

cta.title: Stop shipping orders that were never going to be accepted.
